title: Cadus
extract:
The Cadus is a  Tenno-made staff.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Electricity damage.
 stance polarity matches  Flailing Branch.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High block angle (60°)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.29x))
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.29x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.29x))
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (15.00%)
Very low total damage (130)
Very low damage × attack speed (149.5)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Low crit chance (15.00%)
Low total damage (260)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Low damage × attack speed (299)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Low crit chance (15.00%)
Low total damage (390)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Low damage × attack speed (448.5)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Cadus's blueprint can be purchased from the market for  50,000.

Notes
When combining elements, the innate  Electricity damage is added last.
The  Mk1-Bo cannot be used to craft the Cadus.

Trivia
In WARFRAME (China), the Cadus is named 光棍, which can be translated as a whole to Bachelor (光棍), or in parts to Light (光) and Stick (棍). Guānggùn (光棍) is a reference to the Chinese holiday of Singles' Day, the same date the Cadus was released.
Although the Cadus was not available in the global build prior to Update 30.5 (2021-07-06), it is wielded by the  Trinity Specter guarding the Ceres Junction.
